summary: T15-07 review round 1, reviewer Claude Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5) via Claude Code. Range 3cf8875..b641329. All six story checks ran and exited 0. Every changed path is inside the story's files list. I could not run the built server myself (Bash permission denied), so the `next start` check of /api/v1/health is NOT_RUN. Its coverage here is the mount tests, which pull the mock bundle, call the route module and assert 200 and 503. The author's recorded commands are in the prd.json notes. I found no blocker or high finding. One low finding asks for the recorded `next start` evidence to be re-run.

checks.evidence: next typegen, tsc and tsc -p server/api ran with no errors, so Next's route validator accepts the route module
ruff, mypy, turbo lint and typecheck all passed
pytest 404 passed; web 537 passed; schema 157 passed

checks.criterion: AC2: make web-build passes with the mock bundle and lists the API route
checks.evidence: Route table shows ○ /, ○ /_not-found and ƒ /api/[[...route]]; the bundle pulled was mock-0

checks.criterion: AC1: GET and HEAD are typed (req: Request) => app.fetch(req) wrappers, not handle(app); comment cites hono issue 4877; other methods get 405 through the app; /api/docs redirect; runtime nodejs
checks.evidence: route.ts:15-34 exports `serve: ApiHandler = (req) => app.fetch(req)` for GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE and OPTIONS, runtime='nodejs', and a comment with the issue-4877 URL. mount.test.ts:67-116 asserts that app.fetch is called with the request alone, the 405 problem with Allow: GET, HEAD, and the 308 from /api/docs to /api/v1/docs. The source-grep test (mount.test.ts:80-90) ignores comment lines.

checks.criterion: AC3: outputFileTracingIncludes set for the API route; built server returns bundle_version at /api/v1/health
checks.evidence: next.config.ts:18-20 sets the escaped route key with './data/**/*.json', and tests/next-config.test.ts (4 tests) passes. I could not start `next start` because Bash permission was denied. The mount test 'serves the pulled mock bundle' (mount.test.ts:119-135) covers the same loader path over a pulled bundle. The author's recorded commands are in the prd.json notes (item 5), which also say Vercel tracing cannot be proven locally.

checks.criterion: AC4: route test uses the same app instance and the loader's guard by import; mock manifest with VERCEL_ENV=production gives 503 problem+json on /health and /manifest
checks.evidence: mount.test.ts:138-169 imports `app` from ./index.ts and calls the route. app.ts imports assertDeployable and MockBundleError from lib/bundle.ts and applies the guard in guarded(). The test asserts 503, application/problem+json, that the body contains no 'mock-0' or 'bundle_version', and that the logged error is a MockBundleError.
mount.test.ts:100-116 gets 200 at /api/v1/openapi.json, 404 problems at /api, /api/v2/health and /api/health, and a 308 at /api/docs

checks.criterion: AC6: DEM proxy not built; notes state the human checkpoint and bounds; OpenAPI does not list it
checks.evidence: Grep for cop30 and /dem/ in apps/web (excluding node_modules) found no files. The prd.json note (6) states the G0 cop30_mode=proxy checkpoint is unrecorded and lists the bounds: tile pattern, 4 MB Range limit, one allowed host, 1-day cache.

findings.claim: The built-server health evidence for AC3 was recorded by the author and not re-run in this review.
findings.evidence: Bash permission was denied for `next start`, so this reviewer could not reproduce the 200 mock-0 response from the built server. Recommend the orchestrator re-run the recorded `next start` and curl commands.

findings.claim: The comment says handle(app) type-checks with next 16.4.6 and hono 4.13.18, so the wrapper is not needed for tsc.
findings.evidence: This is a candid note and AC1 asks for the wrapper. PRD 8.5 still names handle(app), and the author's proposed README and PRD wording is left for a human to apply. No action is needed in this story.
